metadata.description: Structural biology and lab skills for Claude

plugins.name: structural-bio
plugins.description: Crystallography skills: crystallization precedent surveys, molecular replacement with Phenix/Phaser, and building unnatural peptides and covalent ligands for Phenix refinement and PDB deposition.

plugins.name: protein-production
plugins.description: Protein production skills: choosing an expression host (E. coli / insect / mammalian / yeast / cell-free) from PDB and literature precedent, and designing, annotating and verifying cloning constructs from SnapGene .dna vectors through to a CRO gene-synthesis order sheet.

plugins.name: sci-reporting
plugins.description: Scientific reporting skills: building a protein or gene family reference as a self-contained HTML dashboard and a matching styled Word report from one researched dataset, with members grouped by purification strategy and every row traceable to a database accession.
